_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits mid-Hope with dead ETF flows, flat funding and only mid-range 30d momentum; base-rate coil dominates so no breaker is visible.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst clear HOLD/CAUTION coil; narrative silent on forward phase and only supplies lower exchange inflows
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-60, 30d momentum 45-65, funding near flat, price range-bound
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum >75 with F&G >70, or momentum <40 plus price breakdown and funding flip negative
